candidate_claim: A present-day official Portugal-Spain land-boundary segment near Penha Garcia that may be eligible for a future Portugal-Castile stable-segment assertion after segment-specific historical and fabric review.

excluded_categories: Olivenza or other CAOP segments whose boundary status is not agreed
Couto Misto and other historically exceptional northern segments
Contienda de Moura and other later-demarcated segments
the southern Cuncos-to-sea section governed by the 1926 convention
any segment without independent, segment-specific evidence of stability on 1444-11-11

license: Official DGT CAOP download; retain source attribution and verify the publisher's current reuse terms before redistribution.

reasons: No independent segment-specific source yet establishes that the selected geometry represents the exact 1444-11-11 Portugal-Castile line.
The current unsplit province fabric has no independently derived two-sided subject edge within the declared 5 km error budget.

source.citation: Direcao-Geral do Territorio, Carta Administrativa Oficial de Portugal, Continente 2023

transformations: selected the official land-boundary record with ICC=PT#ES and ID_TROCO=5394
transformed EPSG:3763 coordinates to EPSG:4326 with pyproj
simplified the line with a 0.001 degree tolerance while preserving topology
serialized one GeoJSON LineString with deterministically ordered properties
